question: Does direct angular rotation of M33 agree with its spectroscopic H I rotation strongly enough to constrain a photon-frequency illusion?

definitions.positive_sign: positive Delta_v_gamma means Doppler spectroscopy overstates the actual transverse motion

claim_boundary: This comparison uses one relative sky component from two maser regions, not a full two-dimensional rotation curve.
The H I tilted-ring model has a conservatively assigned 20 km/s systematic uncertainty.
The TRGB distance is independent of rotation dynamics but remains an electromagnetic distance indicator.
A theory that changes Doppler frequency, angular astrometry, and TRGB luminosity in a coordinated way is not excluded, but must predict all three effects with the same field equations.
